summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Meta Ads Manager Campaigns dashboard. All core requirements verified: 11 campaigns render with Active delivery, all toggles functional, JSON editor works correctly, table scrolling operational.
passed_tests: Dashboard loads without red screen or runtime errors
All 11 campaigns display 'Active' delivery status initially
All 11 Off/On switches are checked/ON initially
Toggle OFF functionality: changes delivery to 'Off' and switch to unchecked
Toggle ON functionality: changes delivery back to 'Active' and switch to checked
Multiple row toggles work correctly (tested c-001, c-002, c-003, c-004)
Horizontal table scrolling works (verified 0px to 182px scroll)
JSON editor drawer opens and closes correctly
JSON editor applies data changes and updates table
All 11 toggles remain functional after JSON operations
